# WaterSafeCheck — U.S. Drinking Water Quality & Safety Database
> Independent data transparency platform providing free, localized drinking water quality reports, lead risk levels, water hardness, and EPA compliance records for 41,000+ U.S. ZIP codes.

## Core Purpose & Authority
WaterSafeCheck aggregates and normalizes public environmental datasets from the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) to provide transparent, plain-English drinking water reports for consumers, researchers, and public health advocates.

## Primary Datasets & Sources
- **EPA SDWIS:** Safe Drinking Water Information System (Federal compliance & violation records for 150,000+ public water systems)
- **EPA ECHO:** Enforcement and Compliance History Online
- **EPA UCMR5:** 5th Unregulated Contaminant Monitoring Rule (PFAS & lithium screening)
- **Consumer Confidence Reports (CCRs):** Annual utility water testing filings
- **USGS:** Regional water hardness and mineral content baselines

## URL Routing Structure
- Homepage: https://www.watersafecheck.com
- ZIP Code Reports: https://www.watersafecheck.com/zip/{5-digit-zip-code} (e.g., `/zip/77001`, `/zip/90210`, `/zip/10001`)
- City Composite Reports: https://www.watersafecheck.com/city/{city-name}-{state-code} (e.g., `/city/houston-tx`, `/city/los-angeles-ca`)
- Statewide Reports: https://www.watersafecheck.com/state/{2-letter-state-code} (e.g., `/state/ca`, `/state/tx`, `/state/ny`)
- Water Quality & Filtration Guide: https://www.watersafecheck.com/water-quality-guide
- Editorial & Methodology: https://www.watersafecheck.com/about

## Scoring Methodology
- **Grade A (85–100):** Meets all EPA National Primary Drinking Water Standards with 0 health violations.
- **Grade B (70–84):** Good compliance; minor past monitoring or administrative notifications.
- **Grade C (55–69):** Moderate compliance concerns; 1–2 health-based violations or elevated lead risk.
- **Grade D (40–54):** Poor compliance; multiple recurring health violations.
- **Grade F (<40):** Significant non-compliance; unresolved violations or active boil water advisories.
